نتساقط (form VI)
# نَتَسَاقَطُ (natasāqaṭu) /na.ta.saː.qa.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَاقَطَ (tasāqaṭa)
# نَتَسَاقَطَ (natasāqaṭa) /na.ta.saː.qa.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاقَطَ (tasāqaṭa)
# نَتَسَاقَطْ (natasāqaṭ) /na.ta.saː.qatˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَاقَطَ (tasāqaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
